You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. Your message said both inbound gate kiosks were showing a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel has no other description of the guard during the outage. Mateo's 11:03 AM message, after kiosk 1 came back, says the guard checked in trailer 8836, and you confirmed both lanes were working at 11:07 AM.

I posted this answer in #inc-vtg-hartford as a reply to your message.
